## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Related Work

Link the issue and any ADR.

## Validation

List the tests, measurements, or source checks performed.

## Security And Privacy

Describe effects on privileges, trust boundaries, network exposure, secrets,
personal data, retention, or auditability. Write "No material change" only after
reviewing each area.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests or evidence cover the behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or real internal infrastructure details are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration effects are documented.
